```{r}
rm(list=ls())
pacman::p_load(dplyr, readr, data.table, janitor, car, splines, VGAM, sandwich, lmtest, marginaleffects, gtsummary, ggplot2)
print("RQ: Among adults, were there differences in Length of Stay of RSV, compared to SARS-Cov-2 and Influenza hospitalization episodes with these infections?")
```
# Study population:
```{r}
setwd('C:/Data/Shared Folder/People/Rubyath/Data/Working files/Intermediate data/Period 1')
std_cc1 <- read_csv2("std_cc1_co_cov.csv")
#Only two cases of SARS-Cov-2, removing them
std_cc1 <- std_cc1 %>% filter(organism_inf_new != "SARS-CoV-2")
#checking the % of repeated patients to account for multiple episodes from same patient
#repetition around 5% or below -> robust clustered SE, GEE will struggle to converge
repeat_pts <- get_dupes(std_cc1, lopnr)
std_cc1 %>% summarise(pct_distinct = (n_distinct(repeat_pts$lopnr))/ (n_distinct(std_cc1$lopnr)) * 100)
```
# A priori setup:
```{r}
#Exposure: organism_inf_new -> Influenza A/B (reference group), RSV, SARS-CoV-2
#Outcome: days_of_stay
#confounders/covariates: age_year, sex, education_level_recoded, mig_background, cci_cat, bac_coinf
#interaction: virus*bac_coinf, virus*age
#confounder and interactions are conceptualized a priori
```
# Data integrity and baseline checks:
```{r}
#checking missing data (covariates) for the need of imputation
colSums(is.na(std_cc1))
#categorizing CCI data as will be used modeled as categorical variable 
std_cc1 <- std_cc1 %>% mutate(cci_cat = factor(case_when(cci_score <= 1 ~ "0-1", cci_score >= 2 & cci_score <= 4 ~ "2-4", cci_score >= 5 ~ ">=5", TRUE ~ NA_character_)))
View(std_cc1)

#categorical variables are factor and set reference group
#continuous variables are numeric
std_cc1$organism_inf_new <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$organism_inf_new), ref = "Influenza A/B")
std_cc1$cci_cat <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$cci_cat), ref = "0-1")
std_cc1$bac_coinf <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$bac_coinf), ref = "No")
std_cc1$age_group <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$age_group), ref = "18-49 years")
std_cc1$sex <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$sex), ref = "K")
std_cc1$education_level_recoded <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$education_level_recoded), ref = "Primary")
std_cc1$mig_background <- relevel(factor(std_cc1$mig_background), ref = "Swedish")

std_cc1$age_year <- as.numeric(std_cc1$age_year)
class(std_cc1$days_of_stay)
std_cc1$days_of_stay <- as.numeric(std_cc1$days_of_stay)

#verifying days_of_stay is non-negative count data, should be integer/numeric without decimals
summary(std_cc1$days_of_stay)
#minimum value 1 and right-skewed tail
hist(std_cc1$days_of_stay, breaks = 50, main = "Distribution of Length of Stay", xlab = "Days", col = "blue")

#multicoliniarity checking
#to remove any covariates/confounder with a GVIF^2 > 5
baseline_poisson <- glm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + age_year + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, data = std_cc1, family = "poisson")
baseline_poisson_ag <- glm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + age_group + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, data = std_cc1, family = "poisson")
vif(baseline_poisson)
vif(baseline_poisson_ag)
rm(baseline_poisson)
rm(baseline_poisson_ag)
```
# Building the inference model:
```{r}
#zero truncated negative binomial, as count data with no zero
#Model 0, empty model
cc1_ztnb_empty <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new, family = posnegbinomial(), data = std_cc1)

#Model 1, adjusting for age (as cont) and sex
cc1_ztnb_base <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + age_year + sex, family = posnegbinomial(), data = std_cc1)
#Model 2, full adjustment, age as cont
cc1_ztnb_full <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + age_year + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = posnegbinomial(zero = NULL), data = std_cc1)

#age as group
#base model
cc1_ztnb_base_ag <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + age_group + sex, family = posnegbinomial(), data = std_cc1)
#full model
cc1_ztnb_full_ag <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + age_group + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = posnegbinomial(zero = NULL), data = std_cc1)

#Models with full adjustment with splines and interaction
#virus and bac_infection, age spline, age group interaction didn't work, as vglm() only handles full-rank models (currently) -> one cell was zero
#model with 3 splines
cc1_ztnb_advanced <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + ns(age_year, 3) + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = posnegbinomial(zero = NULL), data = std_cc1)

#model with 4 splines
cc1_ztnb_advanced2 <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + ns(age_year, 4) + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = posnegbinomial(zero = NULL), data = std_cc1)
```
# Model comparison, relative fit:
```{r}
#loglik gets lower and p < 0.05 significant
#optional, as confounders are a priori
#VGAM::lrtest(cc1_ztnb_base, cc1_ztnb_full)
#VGAM::lrtest(cc1_ztnb_base_ag, cc1_ztnb_full_ag)

#checking AIC
#lowest AIC and BIC, cons BIC may penalize complex model
c(Full = AIC(cc1_ztnb_full), Full_ag = AIC(cc1_ztnb_full_ag), Advanced = AIC(cc1_ztnb_advanced), Advanced2 = AIC(cc1_ztnb_advanced2))
#c(Full = BIC(cc1_ztnb_full), Full_ag = BIC(cc1_ztnb_full_ag), Advanced = BIC(cc1_ztnb_advanced), Advanced2 = BIC(cc1_ztnb_advanced2))

rm(cc1_ztnb_base)
rm(cc1_ztnb_base_ag)
rm(cc1_ztnb_full)
rm(cc1_ztnb_full_ag)
rm(cc1_ztnb_advanced)
```
# Validating assumptions:
```{r}
#overdispersion
mean_days_of_stay <- mean(std_cc1$days_of_stay)
var_days_of_stay <- var(std_cc1$days_of_stay)
vmr <- var_days_of_stay/mean_days_of_stay
print(vmr)

#visualizing the non-linear spline
#plot_predictions(cc1_ztnb_advanced2, condition = "age_year") + ggplot2::labs(title = "Predicted LOS by Age", subtitle = "Modelled as continuous", y = "Expected LOS", x = "Age") + ggplot2::theme_minimal()
#modelled_age <- model.frame(cc1_ztnb_full)$age_year
#supposed to produce a smooth exp curve

#checking log-link linearity
modelled_age <- std_cc1$age_year
raw_residuals <- resid(cc1_ztnb_advanced2, type = "pearson")
vgam_residual_mean <- raw_residuals[,1]
plot(modelled_age, vgam_residual_mean, main = "Pearson residuals vs. Age, ztnb model", ylab = "Residuals(mean equation)", xlab = "Age", col = "blue", pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")
lines(lowess(modelled_age, vgam_residual_mean), col = "black", lwd = 2)
```
# Post diagnostic
```{r}
#Note: Pearson residual struggles with discrete data
#visual residual check
plot(vgam_residual_mean, main = "Pearson residuals, ztnb model", ylab = "Residuals(mean equation)", xlab = "obs", col = "pink", pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "green")

#Post-diagnostic: calculating sum of squared pearson residuals
sum_sq_pearson <- sum(vgam_residual_mean^2)
df_res <- df.residual(cc1_ztnb_advanced2)
dispersion_stat <- sum_sq_pearson / df_res
print(dispersion_stat) 
#after sensitivity test by removing 99th quantile, dispersion stat reduces, possibly the outliers are responsible
summary(cc1_ztnb_advanced2)

#Post-diagnostic: Residuals vs. fitted values
fitted_vals <- fitted(cc1_ztnb_advanced2)
pearson_res <- resid(cc1_ztnb_advanced2, type = "pearson")[,1]
plot(fitted_vals, pearson_res, xlab = "Fitted values (Predicted counts)", ylab = "Pearson Residuals", main = "Residuals vs Fitted values", pch = 20, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")
lines(loess.smooth(fitted_vals, pearson_res), col = "blue", lwd = 2)

#Binning the fitted value
fitted_vals <- fitted(cc1_ztnb_advanced2)[,1]
pearson_res <- resid(cc1_ztnb_advanced2, type = "pearson")[,1]
diag_data <- data.frame(fitted = fitted_vals, resid = pearson_res)
diag_data$broken <- cut(diag_data$fitted, breaks = hist(diag_data$fitted, plot = FALSE)$breaks)
ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = broken, y = resid)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0) + geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.25, color = "grey") + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") + labs(title = "Variance across binned fitted values", x = "Fitted value bins", y = "Pearson residuals") + theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
# Comparing with zt poisson
```{r}
cc1_ztp_advanced <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + ns(age_year, 4) + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = pospoisson(), data = std_cc1)
c(ztnb = AIC(cc1_ztnb_advanced2), ztp = AIC(cc1_ztp_advanced))
#ztp AIC is very high, checking residuals
raw_residuals_p <- resid(cc1_ztp_advanced, type = "pearson")
vgam_residual_mean_p <- raw_residuals_p[,1]

lines(lowess(modelled_age, vgam_residual_mean), col = "black", lwd = 2)

#residuals deviation spread up to 60 for poisson, worst than ztnb, continuing with ztnb
```

# Robust SE calculation
```{r}
B <- 500
num_coefs <- length(coef(cc1_ztnb_advanced2))
boot_coefs <- matrix(NA, nrow = B, ncol = num_coefs)
colnames(boot_coefs) <- names(coef(cc1_ztnb_advanced2))

set.seed(231)
cat("Starting bootstrap...\n")
for(i in 1:B) {
  boot_data <- std_cc1[sample(nrow(std_cc1), replace = TRUE), ]
  tryCatch({boot_model <- vglm(days_of_stay ~ organism_inf_new + ns(age_year, 4) + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = posnegbinomial(zero = NULL), data = boot_data)
  if(isTRUE(as.numeric(boot_model@iter) < 30)) {
  boot_coefs[i,] <- coef(boot_model)
  }
  }, error = function(e) {
})
  if(i %% 100 == 0) cat("Completed iteration:", i, "of", B, "\n")
}
successful_conv <- sum(!is.na(boot_coefs[, 1]))
cat("\nBootstrap completed. Successful convergences:", successful_conv, "out of", B, "\n\n")

robust_se <- apply(boot_coefs, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

results <- data.frame(Estimate = coef(cc1_ztnb_advanced2), Robust_SE = robust_se, z_value = coef(cc1_ztnb_advanced2)/robust_se)
results$p_value <- 2 * (1-pnorm(abs(results$z_value)))
results$CI_lower <- results$Estimate - (qnorm(0.975) * robust_se)
results$CI_upper <- results$Estimate + (qnorm(0.975) * robust_se)

results$IRR <- exp(results$Estimate)
results$CI_lower_exp <- exp(results$CI_lower)
results$CI_upper_exp <- exp(results$CI_upper)
round(results, 4)
```
# Sensitivity test: 1 (removing 99th quantile)

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cutoff <- quantile(std_cc1$days_of_stay, 0.99)
```

# Calculating design effect
```{r}
#bootstrapping of Robust Cluster SE had converegnce issues, so checking how if clustering is really making any big difference
pacman::p_load(lme4, performance)

null_model_pois <- glmer(days_of_stay ~ 1 + (1 | lopnr), 
                         family = poisson(link = "log"), 
                         data = std_cc1, 
                         nAGQ = 0)

rho <- performance::icc(null_model_pois)$ICC_adjusted
cluster_sizes <- std_cc1 %>% count(lopnr) %>% pull(n)
m_adj <- sum(cluster_sizes^2) / sum(cluster_sizes)
deff_robust <- 1 + (m_adj - 1) * rho
deff_robust

#apparently will not need robust clustered SE as deff is 1.02
```
# Additional code: Robust clustered SE: 
```{r, eval = FALSE}
#coeftest didn't work, did bootstrapping, no success, probably becasue of low clustering
#will do a sensitivity check by removing the multiple visits
#extracted coefficients
cc1_coefs <- coef(cc1_ztnb_advanced2)
unique_patients <- unique(std_cc1$lopnr)

#bootstrap iterations
B <- 100
coef_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = B, ncol = length(cc1_coefs))
colnames(coef_matrix) <- names(cc1_coefs)

#cluster bootstrap loop
set.seed(314)
cat("Starting bootstrap. Total iterations:", B, "\n")
for (i in 1:B){
  sampled_ids <- sample(unique_patients, size = length(unique_patients), replace = TRUE)
  boot_data_list <- lapply(sampled_ids, function(id){std_cc1[std_cc1$lopnr == id,]
    })
boot_data <- do.call(rbind, boot_data_list) 
tryCatch({boot_model <- vglm(days_of_stay~organism_inf_new + nr(age_year, 4) + sex + education_level_recoded + mig_background + cci_cat + bac_coinf, family = posnegbinomial(zero = NULL), data = boot_data); coef_matrix[i,] <- coef(boot_model)}, error = function(e){})
if(i %% 10 == 0 || i == B){cat("Completed iteration:", i, "\n")}}
successful_runs <- sum(!is.na(coef_matrix[,1])) 
cat("\nTotal successful convergences:", successful_runs, "out of", B, "\n")

boot_se <- apply(coef_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
z_values <- cc1_coefs/boot_se
p_values <- 2*(1-pnorm(abs(z_values)))
ci_lower_raw <- cc1_coefs - (1.96*boot_se)
ci_upper_raw <- cc1_coefs + (1.96*boot_se)
irr_estimates_bs <- exp(cc1_coefs)
irr_ci_lower <- exp(ci_lower_raw)
irr_ci_upper <- exp(ci_upper_raw)
```
